purpose: Simulation-only multiline instruction-buffer model validation; no production RTL modification or hardware timing claim.
coverage: All four words of a fill; low RAM, canonical BIOS and upper RAM boundaries.
Every cache slot, direct-mapped conflicts and two-way least-recently-used replacement.
CPU/DMA/loader writes with byte-enable 01/10/11 at offsets 0/1/6/7 using aligned physical lanes.
Odd word crossing lines as ordered upper-lane and lower-lane transfers; zero lanes and unrelated writes preserve cached lines.
Distinct canonical BIOS and high RAM addresses; data, non-CPU owners, holes and refresh bypass.
Dynamic enable and compile-time ENABLE=0; exact one-cycle additional hit latency when configured.
Delayed backend acceptance and separated data beats; stable metadata until physical READY.
Input metadata deliberately changed after acceptance; captured word and command remain correct.
CPU cancellation in IDLE invalidates all slots and refuses new CPU requests while DMA/loader requests proceed.
CPU cancellation before each of four accepted burst beats fully drains all beats and returns the discarded value.
Reset during an accepted transaction resets both port ends and invalidates cached lines.
